newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TWO NORWICH PLAYERS CHARGED AFTER TAXI INCIDENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO NORWICH PLAYERS CHARGED AFTER TAXI INCIDENT.

text.p: Two Norwich City players have been charged in connection with an incident involving a taxi driver, a police spokesman said on Friday.
Andy Johnson, 22, a 2.0 million pounds ($3.2 million)) rated midfielder and 28-year-old defender Carl Bradshaw, have been charged with assault and criminal damage.

The two players had been on police bail since being arrested at the club's training ground last month. The alleged incident took place after the Canaries' 3-2 win at Sheffield United, one of Bradshaw's previous clubs, on February 9.
The pair will appear before Norwich magistrates next month.
